data.name: v2.0.2
data.body:
This release publishes all six Hexalith.Agents packages for .NET 11 through NuGet trusted publishing. It includes the bounded NuGet indexing wait and the synchronized Platform CI repairs.

### Compatibility

- Packages target `net11.0`; applications must support .NET 11. Source builds use SDK `11.0.100`.
- Provider-catalog terminal command status remains unavailable through the default SDK reader: EventStore 5.1.1 rejects reserved `system` scope on its workload status route. An approved platform status route or host-provided scoped reader is required. See [README](https://github.com/Hexalith/Hexalith.Agents/blob/v2.0.2/README.md).

All six NuGet packages were downloaded and their ordinary archive contents verified against the retained GitHub release archives and source provenance.
